title: Best planning app by a mile
body: Having tried so many different to-do / planning apps, Sunsama is in a different league to the rest. The ux is intuitive and when connected to my work calendar it does an excellent job of making it clear when I am overestimating my capacity (which is most days) and forces me to be more ruthless with prioritising my work.
author: Nzthim

title: Sunsama Support email received today…
body:
This is the email that Sunsama sent me today…
‘Your Sunsama workspace will be deleted soon,
Your Sunsama workspace is inactive and will be deleted soon,
Your Sunsama pro subscription was cancelled on November 3rd 2025,
Your workspace and all of its data is scheduled to be deleted in 15 days,
If you'd like to keep your data, please upgrade to a pro plan.’

… that’s harsh!!… I won’t be renewing, there’s cheaper and better out there!!
author: Orijan

title: Useful
body: Been using this for sooo many years even before it was a fully fledged iOS app, the basics are what keep me paying it does it well. A simple to do list for each day, move tasks around. Helps a lot for my momentum.
author: AmyLouise2525

title: Not too sure..
body: Ill take the word of mouth of other people and go along with the assumption that this app is good, when i tried signing in & begin using it for myself, it gave me a notification that an unknown device was wanting to log into my account. Is this supposed to happen? Im anxious about stuff and i wanna make sure about things, the data usages below are also kind of a ringing bell, considering so much is needed just for a time-allocation app
author: Sir Vontholomew Visor Esquire

title: Best Productivity Software I’ve Ever Used
body: I’ve used a wide range of productivity/time management software and none have been anywhere near as good as this. The Siri integration is amazing for quickly capturing to-dos. The only fault I could find with the mobile apps is that they can feel a little clunky, and some Lock Screen widgets would be great. All in all an amazing piece of software that I could not run my life without!
author: Tommorino

title: Essential to my life
body: Can’t live without this app, both the mobile and desktop version. As someone who works for himself and spends a lot of time on personal development, organising my day is a critical task, and Sunsama helps me do it in a brilliantly efficient manner.
author: AshtonJTL

title: Great app, but...
body: This app is great online but on iPad and iPhone the screen to enter the login code appears for a second and then goes blank... Frustrating. I haven't managed to get it working yet.
author: DragonsNeverDie

title: Best productivity app
body: New app desktop app is the full suites and phone app like a mini version but exactly what’s needed. My favourite part is the time tracking functionality and the seamless integrations with Google calendar and todoist it’s as if they’re all in one app the way an integration should be
author: shamrantrayner
